changelog:
- Improved documentation with detailed instructions on creating and testing new skills from plain-language descriptions
- Clarified when and how to use invocation control fields (`disable-model-invocation`, `user-invocable`)
- Emphasized minimal context cost and alignment with latest skill spec
- Added a step-by-step skill authoring checklist and troubleshooting tips
- Provided templates, examples, and best practices for robust skill development and installation
summary: Generate a new Claude Code skill from a plain-language description — decides invocation control (disable-model-invocation vs user-invocable), arguments (argument-hint, $ARGUMENTS), and context cost, then scaffolds and tests it.
